name: Consistencia de Contacto Visual
description: Analiza la consistencia del contacto visual en video para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Eye Contact Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes eye contact patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **Mirada Direction Estimación**: Per-frame gaze direction is estimated from iris position, eye corner landmarks, and head pose. The gaze vector is decomposed into horizontal and vertical components relative to the camera, determining whether the subject appears to be making eye contact.

2. **Ojo Contact Patrón Análisis**: Natural eye contact follows specific behavioral patterns — during conversation, humans alternate between direct eye contact and glancing away (typically maintaining eye contact 60-70% of time). The method models these patterns and checks whether the subject's gaze behavior follows expected psychological norms.

3. **Mirada - Head Coordination**: When shifting gaze, natural eye movements combine eye rotation (saccades) with head rotation in coordinated vestibulo-ocular patterns. The method verifies gaze-head coordination — deepfakes may produce eye movements decoupled from head motion or show unnaturally stable gaze during head turns.

4. **Bilateral Mirada Consistencia**: Both eyes should converge on the same target point (vergence). The method checks that left and right eye gaze vectors intersect at a plausible depth. Deepfakes may produce strabismus-like artifacts where eyes appear to look in slightly different directions.

5. **Temporal Mirada Naturalness**: Gaze changes include saccades (fast, ballistic movements), smooth pursuit (tracking moving objects), and fixations (stable gaze). The method analyzes the temporal structure of gaze signals for correct velocity profiles. AI-generated eye movements often lack natural saccadic dynamics, producing either unrealistically smooth or jittery gaze patterns.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante eye contact consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Yang, X. et al. (2019). Exposing Deep Fakes Using Inconsistent Head Poses. ICASSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
